purpose: Deterministic next development sample before mechanism adaptation, not blind independent evaluation
eligibility: Exactly two members; neither test_path_hint nor nested_in_function; exclude any source path belonging to a previously reviewed result member, development seed or pilot. Test hint is heuristic, not resolved cfg.
ordering: Ascending SHA256 of UTF8('crate-contract-next-v1:' + sorted member IDs joined with ':'); no similarity score or outcome sorting.
diversity: Greedy at most one selected pair involving any already selected source file; no claim this establishes semantic family independence.
shortfall: Retain actual count without relaxing exclusions, changing seed or replenishing from known cases.
scope: Only the existing SCC-selected population; cannot measure missed non-token-similar responsibilities or whole-repository recall. Previous indirect exposure cannot be excluded.
after_selection: Archive all selected source bytes before semantic reading. Record interface compatibility, candidate proposition, documentation needs and missing evidence without assigning optimization labels.
evaluation_targets: whole-behavior comparison only with explicit common input mapping
local mechanism sharing without forcing whole equivalence
normative responsibility with explicit owner authority
documentation_policy: May require compliant provider-owned documents or researcher-labeled provisional declarations; existing omissions are remediable inputs, not exclusion or a method failure.
stop: One deterministic draw, complete inclusion/exclusion audit, no outcome-based replacement. No new effectiveness or patent-readiness claims.
